title: Formative assessment: from evidence to action
audience: University lecturers developing formative assessment practice
journey_intent: Build a practical conceptual model of formative assessment as an evidence-to-action loop, then return to that model with richer judgement and feasible design choices.

sections.title: What formative assessment is for
sections.purpose: Orient the reader away from instrument-first thinking.
sections.knowledge_focus: Formative purpose versus assessment instrument choice
sections.conceptual_move: Reframe formative assessment as a purpose for evidence use
sections.synthesis: Purpose, not instrument choice, defines formative assessment.

sections.title: Evidence to action
sections.purpose: Establish the central mental model for the resource.
sections.knowledge_focus: Intended learning, evidence, interpretation, and action
sections.synthesis: Evidence becomes formative through interpretation and subsequent action.

sections.title: Useful feedback
sections.purpose: Deepen the loop at the point of feedback use.
sections.knowledge_focus: Feedback as usable judgement, not comment volume
sections.synthesis: Feedback is formative when it informs realistic next steps.

sections.title: Criteria and exemplars
sections.purpose: Make quality inspectable for lecturers and learners.
sections.synthesis: Criteria and exemplars support shared judgement of quality.

sections.title: Peers and self
sections.purpose: Distribute judgement without inventing new process stages.
sections.knowledge_focus: Peer and self-assessment as contributors to the same loop
sections.conceptual_move: Extend actors while preserving the four-part model
sections.synthesis: Peers and learners can contribute judgement and action inside the same loop.

sections.title: Designing the loop
sections.purpose: Synthesise the journey into reusable design practice.
sections.knowledge_focus: Integrated formative design choices across scales
sections.conceptual_move: Return to the S2 model with richer judgement and feasible action
sections.synthesis: Design asks what useful action can follow from evidence.

learning_outcomes.statement: Distinguish formative purpose from assessment instruments.
Explain how evidence becomes formative through interpretation and action.
Use criteria, exemplars, peers, and self-assessment inside one design loop.
